ANSWER THIS BEFORE EDITING EITHER SIDE: at the line above, is the run a DEFECT or the POINT?

A DEFECT -- a continued literal kept the next line's indentation, or a generator ate the backslash before the file was written -- is the case this guard exists for. Put the string on one line, or end the line with a backslash so Rust drops the newline and the indentation with it.

THE POINT -- a fixture quoting the defect, or data whose indentation IS the value -- belongs in EXEMPT above, by file, with the reason written beside it. Those two are different exemptions and must not share an entry.
The question is asked rather than the edits offered, because an offered pair gets chosen by distance, and here the cheap one is an exemption.
